[[The Keeper]] is a [[Necromancer]] [[boss]] that guards the entrance to the second level of the [[Cathedral of Flames]].

== Locations ==
* [[Depths of Tyria]]
** {{NPC location|Cathedral of Flames}}

== Skills ==
* {{skill icon|Life Siphon}}
* {{skill icon|Life Transfer}} ([[elite]])
* {{skill icon|Signet of Lost Souls}}
* {{skill icon|Vampiric Gaze}}
* {{skill icon|Vampiric Swarm}}

== Items dropped ==
* [[Scepter of the Keeper]] ([[unique]])

== Trivia ==
* It is possible that the name "The Keeper" and the [[profession]] of Necromancer mean The Keeper could be based upon the entity of the same name from the ''[[w:The Sword of Truth|Sword of Truth]]'' Series by [[w:Terry Goodkind|Terry Goodkind]]. <!-- His weapon is not the same as his unique item (note: not necessarily, there are two different screenshots of him where he is wielding two different staves. he possibly also wield his unique item occasionally) -->
